classification.difficultyReason: Read filled-dot positions on explicitly labelled number lines and write those values as sets, including a singleton.

content.prompt: Write down, using set notation, the set represented by the filled dots.

spec.description: Ticks labelled 0–7; red filled membership markers at 1, 2, 4 and 6.
spec.answerVisibility: The marked values are supplied; set notation is the response.

answer.worked: The filled dots mark 1, 2, 4 and 6, so the set is $\{1,2,4,6\}$.

spec.description: Ticks labelled 0–7; red filled membership markers at 0, 2, 3, 5 and 7.
spec.answerVisibility: The marked values are supplied; set notation is the response.

answer.worked: The filled dots mark 0, 2, 3, 5 and 7, so the set is $\{0,2,3,5,7\}$.

spec.description: Ticks labelled 0–7; red filled membership markers at 2, 3, 4 and 5.
spec.answerVisibility: The marked values are supplied; set notation is the response.

answer.worked: The filled dots mark 2, 3, 4 and 5, so the set is $\{2,3,4,5\}$.

spec.description: Ticks labelled 0–7; one red filled membership marker at 2.
spec.answerVisibility: The marked value is supplied; set notation is the response.

answer.worked: Only 2 is marked, so the one-element set is $\{2\}$.
